findings: Proposed Tornado-only callback preserves saved stage then byte decrement, supported eager plan repair state, one model-11/logs-1 allocation at current wrapped position, allocation-gated signed -100 work, exhausted-work retirement, later attacker/live-plan bookkeeping and final stage/retirement debris gate.

Established unbounded wood adapter is explicitly limited; supplied failure is a component case, not native pool-exhaustion parity. No global allocator, Earthquake, radius or scheduling changes are admitted.

Three initial tests compose actual stepLiveTornado to stepTornado and production damage callback. They assert missing loose wood, plan identity through repeated exhaustion, actual tick cleanup and protected/rejected/preparation/retired exclusions. Stationary fixtures are controlled Node evidence only.

Reviewer allocation-attribution correction is incorporated: debris legitimately consumes effect IDs; log has initial nextId before debris and exact total +1 belongs to the final-stage-unchanged component case.
Retirement case now captures a nonempty initial terrain footprint, then requires those exact indices and all target membership to be removed by real tick.

Fresh M2 acquisition is supported as a preparation direction by authored linked rewards and retained ordinary observations. Prior failed checker envelope stays failed. Current real recipient, route, stock, public cast, source/clock and synchronous impact evidence remain future run acceptance.
requiredCandidateCoverage: Retain exact failing-base receipt before runtime edits and passing candidate receipt afterward.
Add the proposed helper failure/order, zero-to-255 stage wrap, same-final-stage no debris/no wood RNG, attacker 255, no writes to retired plan and already-exhausted no-allocation cases.
Keep existing Tornado refresh/person/tree/gate and Earthquake checks; quality and full standards remain coordinated gates.
ordinaryWitnessScope: Preparation only. Freeze actual caller/observer implementation and numeric row/time/export limits, passive forwarding and cleanup, target/current-world/input identity before separately reviewed browser admission. No launch or profile reconstruction accepted here.
